name: Extract audio from a video
description: Pull the audio track out of any video (.mp4/.mov/.webm/...) entirely in the browser with FFmpeg WASM, as an .m4a ready to transcribe. No upload, no key, no cost — the video never leaves the tab.
cost: none — nothing leaves the browser, so there is no model and no key

core.loaded: on first extraction — a visitor who only reads the page fetches none of it
on page load, to UPGRADE the API that is already published

third-party.why: sg-video.js hardcodes this origin and accepts no override today
third-party.note: allowed in this page's CSP only; no key and no user data reach it — the video never leaves the tab

api.published_as: window.__tool (assigned during module evaluation — no network wait, no lazy init)
api.ready_event: tool:ready (fires on publish and again on upgrade; window.__toolStatus.ready is the durable fact)
api.status_probe: window.__toolStatus — { ready, mode: 'local'|'sg-tool-api', methods, engine }; always present

actions.name: extractAudio

params.withAudio: true to include base64 — off by default, a soundtrack is large

actions.returns: { filename, mime, bytes, sourceName, sourceBytes, reencoded, tookMs } (+ base64 when withAudio)

actions.name: prepare
actions.returns: { ready } — loads the 32 MB FFmpeg core up front

actions.name: probe
actions.returns: duration and dimensions, without loading FFmpeg

actions.name: getLastAudio
actions.returns: the last result's metadata, or null

actions.name: sendToApp
actions.returns: { name, size, from } — hands the audio to /app/ for transcription

notes.codecs: The audio is stream-copied (-vn -c:a copy), which is lossless and fast, and works for AAC — phone and WhatsApp video. Opus in WebM (screen recordings, web downloads) cannot be copied into an .m4a, so the tool re-encodes to AAC and sets reencoded: true rather than reporting the underlying error, which wrongly claims the file has no audio stream.
notes.first-run: The first extraction downloads ~32 MB of FFmpeg WASM, then the browser caches it. Call prepare() to pay that cost up front.
notes.privacy: There is no backend. The video is read in the tab, processed in the tab, and the result stays there until it is downloaded or handed to /app/ through same-origin storage.
